_about: Inventory items (V2.2). Ownership is never stored twice: 'owned' is a condition over story flags (GameState.check), so the inventory is always a view of the save. 'found_flag' is set when the item is picked up and never cleared, which stops pickups repeating; items are used up by flags that make 'owned' false (e.g. the rope is gone once 'made_hooked_line' is set). 'actions' lists what the inventory offers: inspect, hold (to use on something in the world), combine, light. Icons are 16x16. See docs/INVENTORY_SYSTEM.md.

items.name: Iron Tuning Pin
items.description: Mara's family kept it for generations. A bell ringed by thirteen marks is stamped into its head.
items.inspect: Heavier than it looks, and cold, the way iron is cold after a night outside. It was made for the bell, and only the bell.

items.name: Iron Key
items.description: Orin hid it in the spine of the Bellkeeper's Ledger. A small bell is stamped on the bow.
items.inspect: It opened the north gate. Orin's keys were always for one door each.

items.name: Tobin's Lantern
items.description: "Bring it back lit." You keep it wrapped in your coat, saving the wick for the road home.
items.inspect: Tobin's lamp from the square. It lit the Mistbound Path for you. It's for the way back.

items.name: Old Lantern
items.description: A watchman's lantern with an iron shutter. Its flame has burned without oil for longer than anyone remembers. (L: open or close the shutter.)
items.inspect: The flame doesn't flicker when you breathe on it. Whatever keeps it burning isn't oil. The shutter slides closed with a soft iron click.

items.name: Strong Rope
items.description: A coil of tarred rope, still sound. Long enough to reach down over an edge.
items.inspect: Good hemp, tarred against the damp. On its own it would only slide off smooth iron.

items.name: Iron Hook
items.description: A heavy grappling hook with an eye for a line. Made to catch and hold.
items.inspect: The eye at the top is worn smooth. Something used to be tied through it.

items.name: Hooked Line
items.description: The iron hook knotted to the strong rope. Something to catch what has fallen out of reach.
items.inspect: A line that can go down over an edge and come back up holding something.

items.name: Watchman's Token
items.description: An old iron token. Two initials have been scratched into its surface: E. and a letter worn too smooth to read.
items.inspect: Someone carried this for a long time. The edge is worn where a thumb rubbed it.

combinations.text: You knot the hook to the rope's end. Now it can catch something out of reach.

refusals.text: A fine instrument, but not the tool for this job.
The hook has nowhere to attach to the lantern.
The pin is for the bell. You won't risk it on anything else.
The key did its one job. It isn't a tool.
The lantern is better off in your hand.
